fix(models): derive tier from billing.multiplier instead of capabilities.tier

- Add _extract_multiplier() and _get_tier_from_multiplier() helpers

- 0.51-1.5 → standard
- >1.5 → premium
- Missing/negative → standard (silent fallback, no warning)
